errors.evidence: The pie chart visually displays only four sectors for categories with non-zero values. The fifth category has a value of 0 and is not represented by a sector.
The green sector (value 2) is not uniquely the largest; it is the same size as the red sector, which also has a value of 2.

errors.text_span: Най-малкият сектор е черен, етикетиран като „друго (посочете какво)“ със стойност 0.
errors.evidence: There is no black sector in the chart. The category "друго (посочете какво)" has a value of 0 and is therefore not visually represented as a sector in the pie.

errors.text_span: Всички сектори са разположени във визуален ред по низходящ размер, започвайки от най-големия в долния ляв ъгъл и продължавайки по часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not arranged in descending order of size. Starting from the green sector (value 2) and moving clockwise, the sequence of values is 2, 1, 1, 2, which is not a descending order.
